title: Missing Anti-Corruption Layer (Upstream Conformist Spill)
pattern: Directly using external/upstream API structures and vocabulary deep inside the downstream system's core business logic.
why_bad: Downstream context loses its architectural autonomy. A refactoring in the upstream system's API immediately breaks downstream business logic.
detection: Functions in local core modules directly accepting and processing types imported from external dependencies or raw API crates.
counterexample: Shared kernels explicitly designed and mutually agreed upon by both collaborating teams.
source: *Domain-Driven Design* by Eric Evans (Chapter 14, "Anticorruption Layer", p. 93-94); *Implementing Domain-Driven Design* (Chapter 13, p. 101).
